summary: Your twelfth teach-back. You answer a colleague who already uses function calling, explain the difference between a tool and an MCP server in 5 sentences with a fair case for a plain tool, check six key points, and test your explanation against the evidence of your own runs.
goal: Explain a tool versus an MCP server.

items.text: Write what you would answer the colleague and one case where an MCP server is not worth it
Explain a tool versus an MCP server in 5 sentences or a 60-second voice note
Tick the six key points your explanation said clearly and count them
Check your explanation against the evidence and say who talks to the server
Write a better sentence for the biggest gap
Play the Tool or MCP game to the end and see your score
